step.welcome.headline: Your AI workspace, fully under your control
step.welcome.description: Cradle is an open-source AI platform that connects your models, agents, and workspaces in one place — built for engineers who want depth, not handholding.
step.chat.headline: A composer built for real work
step.chat.description: Send messages, attach files, reference workspace context, and invoke agents — all from a single, keyboard-native interface.
step.workspace.headline: Every project, always in context
step.workspace.description: Connect your local directories and let Cradle index your code. Agents read the full project graph so you don't have to paste files manually.
step.agents.headline: Agents that actually do things
step.agents.description: Run multi-step agent loops backed by real tools — browse the web, execute shell commands, manage files, and call any API.
step.done.headline: Start building today
step.done.description: Cradle is ready. Open a new chat, connect a workspace, or explore the settings to configure your preferred models and providers.
